converted_left.meaning: Left report expressed on supported common endpoint scale

converted_right.meaning: Right report expressed on supported common endpoint scale

protocol_difference.meaning: Signed difference of linked source protocol estimates

protocol_ratio.meaning: Descriptive ratio of linked source protocol estimates

protocol_log_ratio.meaning: Dependent log representation of protocol comparison

common_difference.meaning: Difference under declared common estimand model

common_ratio.meaning: Ratio under declared common estimand model

common_log_ratio.meaning: Dependent log representation of common comparison

difference_variance.meaning: Variance of the linked reported-protocol difference under the actual joint selected-estimator covariance; no common-condition or common-mean equivalence is required.

difference_standard_uncertainty.meaning: Square root of that reported-protocol difference variance; no common-mean model or sampling distribution is inferred.

standardized_difference.meaning: Signed standardized discrepancy with stated variance meaning

squared_standardized_difference.meaning: Squared standardized discrepancy from the same measurements

combined_estimate.meaning: Common unbiased quantity estimate under the declared covariance model; for V_D=0 and L=R the shared value is unique even when the unbiased weight allocation is nonunique.

combined_variance.meaning: Variance of the common estimate under the declared covariance model; for V_D=0 and L=R, PSD implies V_L=V_R=C_LR=v and every unbiased weight allocation has variance v.

combined_standard_uncertainty.meaning: Square root of that common-estimate variance, including zero under a declared known zero-variance model; nonunique weights do not erase this quantity.

observed_interference.meaning: Observed nuisance contribution on applicable selected estimate scale

corrected_estimate.meaning: Measured corrected quantity under applicable estimate scale model

required_interference_scenario.meaning: Required signed observed mixture contribution if true quantity equals H

required_nuisance_equivalent_scenario.meaning: Required nuisance equivalent on selected report scale under two explicit stipulations
